Gravel Root Joe Pye Weed; Queen of the Meadow; Raíz de eupatorio. Profile Gravel root is the root of Eupatorium purpureum (Compositae) and has diuretic, antilithic, and antirheumatic properties. It is used for renal and urinary calculus and other urinary-tract disor- ders, and has also been used for gout and rheumatism.
